Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Database Developer with strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL to join our Sportsbook and Platform teams. The role will focus on designing, developing, and optimising database solutions that support high-volume, business-critical systems. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of SQL Server performance, scalability, and reliability, and is able to act as a bridge between Development and DBA teams.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain efficient T-SQL code, including stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database scripts
Work on database design and data modelling activities, including the design and maintenance of high-throughput stored procedures for critical system operations, ensuring that solutions are scalable, maintainable, aligned with business requirements, and that database logic is implemented in the most appropriate and performant way
Analyse, troubleshoot, and optimise complex queries, execution plans, indexes, and database objects to improve performance, reduce bottlenecks, and actively contribute to the investigation and resolution of production incidents related to database behaviour, performance, or data integrity
Support Developers in writing efficient SQL queries and reviewing database-related changes before they reach production
Support second-level support team in the analysis and resolution of escalated operational requests that require database or code-level understanding, providing guidance on data checks, safe database operations, and issue assessment
Provide technical guidance on when logic should remain within SQL Server, particularly for high-volume or performance-sensitive operations, rather than being moved into application code
Contribute to the continuous improvement of database development standards, best practices, and review processes
Define and contribute to data retention policies, ensuring that data lifecycle, storage, archiving, and deletion strategies are aligned with business, technical, performance, and compliance requirements
Act as a technical bridge between development and database administration, helping ensure that application needs and database operational requirements are properly aligned
 Requirements
Minimum of 5 years of experience in database development, with strong hands-on experience using Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL
Working knowledge of .NET applications and data access patterns, including experience with
Dapper or similar lightweight ORM/micro-ORM frameworks, to effectively support Developers and optimise interactions between application code and SQL Server
Advanced knowledge of stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, indexes, transactions, and query optimisation
Strong experience analysing execution plans and identifying performance bottlenecks in complex or high-volume systems
Solid understanding of indexing strategies, locking, blocking, deadlocks, isolation levels, and transactional consistency
Proven ability to design and optimise database solutions for performance, scalability, and reliability under heavy load
Strong understanding of database design principles, data modelling, normalisation, and relational database architecture
Experience supporting production systems and troubleshooting performance or stability issues in business-critical environments
Good understanding of DBA-related activities such as monitoring, backups, maintenance plans, SQL Server Agent jobs, security, and availability considerations
Ability to work closely with Developers and DBAs, translating application requirements into efficient and sustainable database solutions
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations clearly
Previous experience in the iGaming industry would be considered as a plus
 Benefits
Private health insurance;
Bi-Monthly company wide social and team building activities;
Hybrid & Remote work arrangements;
Flexible working hours;
Daily paid meal;
Wellbeing day;
Training and Development opportunities
 Logifuture operates across seven countries, with headquarters in Malta and additional offices in the UK (London), Italy (Parma & Lecce), Austria (Innsbruck), Serbia (Kragujevac), Romania (Bucharest) and UAE (Dubai). The majority of our roles listed on our careers page are not restricted by location, giving prospective employees the flexibility to choose any of our offices. Furthermore, we also collaborate with consultants based outside these locations, broadening our talent pool and allowing us to remain agile and competitive in the global market
 In addition at Logifuture we embrace equality and diversity. We do not discriminate and our values of delivering results together, support this statement. We are determined to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to contribute their unique skills and experiences.
